The '''2013–14 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas]] in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013–14]] [[college basketball]] season. The team's [[head coach]] is [[Mike Anderson (basketball, born 1959)|Mike Anderson]]. The team played their home games at [[Bud Walton Arena]] in [[Fayetteville, Arkansas]], as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]].

==Preseason==
Coach Mike Anderson completed his second season by posting a 19–13 record during the [[2012–13 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|2012–2013 season]], where the Razorbacks finished seventh in the SEC. The Razorbacks did not participate in any postseason play.

==Postseason==
For the first time since the [[2007–08 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2007–08 season]], the Razorbacks were invited to a postseason tournament, earning a spot in the [[2014 NIT|NIT]] after winning 21 games in the regular season. Arkansas drew [[Indiana State Sycamores men's basketball|Indiana State]] as its first round opponent, the first meeting between the two programs since the [[1979 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|1979 Midwest regional final]], and defeated the Sycamores 91-71 at home. Arkansas fell to [[California Golden Bears men's basketball|California]] on the road in the second round, 75-64.
